643-1168-3000-3510.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-1168-3000-3510.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

678-4939-5686.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

1445-4871-7422-8250.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7422-8250.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

240-5470-7730-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5470-7730-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-7328-8176.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7328-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

4247-7084-7893.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5231-5468.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Repeat.

5170-6132-7918-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4399-4518-6626-7399.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6626-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-5570-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
5231-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1738-3533-7416.notablePrerequisites: You have Professor Dellian Fel's emblem.
1738-3533-7416.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Doomgape triggers, causing you to sacrifice Serra Avatar and gain life equal to its toughness.
Professor Dellian Fel's emblem triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

1806-2060-2292-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

423-1437-5621-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-5621-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1029-2757-7010.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gran-Gran.
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Gran-Gran.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-5243-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5243-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

147-2034-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

625-1978-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
625-1978-5457.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

645-1267-3967-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3967-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-1477-2060-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-1477-2060-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

4929-6805-6824.description:
Activate Royal Herbalist by paying {2} and exiling the top card of your library, causing you to gain 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4593-5070.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4593-5070.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2511-3652-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

108-3129-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

188-2178-5368.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
188-2178-5368.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2743-2990.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
2743-2990.description:
Cast Sakashima's Will by paying {3}{U}, causing each creature you control to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1218-1819-3244.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards between your graveyard and library.
1218-1819-3244.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your library with your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card in your graveyard and library, causing each opponent to get that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

413-3542-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
413-3542-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
